statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of underlying rhythm disturbances.
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered.
The service was ordered to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The diagnosis codes billed were I48.91, I49.5, and I49.9.
The denial reason code is CO-197.
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date.
